Quick summary of the options in the SOW (attached):
- Option A (term extension, same tier): 12-month extension, keep current committed capacity, add weekly cross-region failover testing. Does NOT include reserved APAC capacity — APAC served via cold failover (higher latency during failover). Estimated delta: +6% on renewal run-rate.
- Option B (term + tier upgrade): 12-month extension, move to Gold tier (higher reserved throughput), add dedicated warm-standby in APAC sized for 20% of peak EU requests (auto-burst to 100% on failover). - Capacity top-up addendum: one-time committed top-up of GPU-hours (we modeled +40% peak commit) — reduces per-token cost and improves latency SLOs for peak hours.
